blocks.source: assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 1), (2, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 1) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)", 'customers': "SELECT CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(name AS STRING) AS name, CAST(region AS STRING) AS region, CAST(signup_date AS DATE) AS signup_date FROM VALUES (1, 'a', 'N', DATE'2024-01-01'), (2, 'b', 'N', DATE'2024-01-01') AS customers(customer_id, name, region, signup_date)"}) == [(1, 'a')], 'two paid orders'

assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 100) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)", 'order_items': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(sku AS STRING) AS sku, CAST(qty AS INT) AS qty, CAST(unit_price AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS unit_price FROM VALUES (1, 'A', 1, 10), (1, 'B', 2, 10), (1, 'C', 3, 10) AS order_items(order_id, sku, qty, unit_price)"}) == [(1, '100.00', 6)], 'order with three lines'

assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 100) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)", 'order_items': 'SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST(NULL AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS sku, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS qty, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS unit_price) WHERE FALSE'}) == [(1, '100.00', 0)], 'order without lines'

assert rows_on(q, **{'employees': "SELECT CAST(emp_id AS INT) AS emp_id, CAST(name AS STRING) AS name, CAST(dept AS STRING) AS dept, CAST(manager_id AS INT) AS manager_id, CAST(salary AS INT) AS salary, CAST(hire_date AS DATE) AS hire_date FROM VALUES (1, 'boss', 'X', NULL, 100, DATE'2020-01-01'), (2, 'peer', 'X', 1, 100, DATE'2020-01-01'), (3, 'low', 'X', 1, 50, DATE'2020-01-01') AS employees(emp_id, name, dept, manager_id, salary, hire_date)"}) == [('peer', 100, 'boss', 100)], 'equal pay counts'

assert rows_on(q, **{'order_items': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(sku AS STRING) AS sku, CAST(qty AS INT) AS qty, CAST(unit_price AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS unit_price FROM VALUES (1, 'A', 1, 1), (1, 'B', 1, 1), (1, 'B', 1, 1), (2, 'A', 1, 1), (2, 'B', 1, 1), (3, 'A', 1, 1) AS order_items(order_id, sku, qty, unit_price)"}) == [('A', 'B', 2)], 'pair in two orders, duplicate line'
